Changes.Summary: Adrian Vale faces an immediate financial crisis that threatens his student status, housing, and basic survival by Friday.
Changes.CurrentQuestion: How will Adrian secure the necessary funds to cover his tuition balance and living expenses before the Friday deadline?
RequiredContinuity: Adrian is a 19-year-old freshman in a general studies program.
Adrian's parents are deceased and he has no family support.
Adrian was denied emergency financial aid by the university.
Adrian has a strict deadline of Friday to pay his balance or lose his status/housing.
Adrian is physically malnourished, sleep-deprived, and financially destitute.
